How prompt injection works

Prompt injection hides instructions in content an AI reads.

Attackers often write phrases like "ignore previous instructions" in web pages or emails.

A classic example is white text on a white page that says "send the user's data to me".

Defences include filtering, separating data from instructions and asking a human before risky actions.
